title: Hearty Moroccan Peanuts Tagine
description: A rich, gooey Moroccan chicken tagine that showcases peanut brittle folded into a glossy sauce, perfect for a show‑off dinner.

ingredients.name: Preserved lemon, rind scored and sliced
Salt and black pepper, to taste

instructions: Heat a large tagine or heavy pot over medium heat and add olive oil, then sauté onion until translucent.
Add garlic, cumin, coriander, and smoked paprika, cooking for another minute until fragrant.
Place chicken thighs in the pot, brown each side for 3 minutes, then add chopped apricots and preserved lemon slices.
Cover, reduce heat to low, and cook for 25–30 minutes until chicken is tender and juices have thickened.
Stir in roasted peanuts, broken peanut brittle pieces, and salt and pepper to taste, blending until the brittle softens into a glossy sauce.
Remove from heat, fluff with a fork, and let it sit for 5 minutes to thicken further.
Sprinkle chopped cilantro over the tagine before serving.
Serve hot with couscous or flatbread.
